static_traits.name: Zhang Derui
static_traits.family_status: Living alone,close to parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues have become tense due to Self-doubt and comparison
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness;no similar psychological issues in the past;has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, can describe emotions and events, relatively high cooperativeness, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I feel like a failure because no one bought my artwork when I tried to pursue a career as an artist. This has led to feelings of inadequacy and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this sense of inadequacy and Self-doubt has affected my overall well-being and happiness,which prompts me to seek counseling at this time.
growth_experiences: About three years ago,Zhang Derui tried to pursue art as a Career development direction,investing a great deal of time and energy in creating,but no one bought his works;this setback triggered intense stress and disappointment,and since then self-evaluation like 'I am not good enough,I am a failure' has persisted.He began frequently comparing his current Work and financial situation with the image of a 'successful Artist',feeling the need to constantly prove himself and earn more money,gradually forming persistent low self-esteem and Self-doubt.

special_situations.event: During the period of trying to be an Artist,no one bought the artworks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the works cannot be sold,it proves I am not good enough/am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracting attention with work and hobbies, striving to prove one's own value through work and a higher income
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This proves I am a failure,the artistic path has no hope

special_situations.event: Seeing successful Artists,or Thinking about doing art again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot reach their level,it means I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding trying art again,investing more in current Work to reduce the possibility of being negated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never succeed like them,I will fail again

special_situations.event: A sibling has not yet attended the birthday party
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family members do not come,it means they do not care about me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls the event and avoids communicating with that sibling to avoid deeper hurt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not value me,this party is a failure

special_situations.event: Comparing current Work and income with the ideal image of a 'successful Artist'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not earn much,am not a successful Artist,I am not worthy,have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly pushing myself to earn more money,increasing comparison to seek others' approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,I must prove myself through earning money and achievements

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed (to be seen and valued in artistic pursuits and intimate relationships)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated,Being rejected,being labeled a 'failure'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected by avoiding direct conflict and avoiding trying again
Maintains a sense of self-worth through work and earning money
Using Rationalization to weaken hurt feelings(telling oneself the other person may have reasons,that one is 'too sensitive')

object_relations.object_representation: Cold,relatives who do not value me(absentees)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or facing a sibling's absence and considering communicating with them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting the other's absence as 'not caring about me/not valuing me',positioning oneself as the rejected one
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoid directly expressing hurt,use buffering statements(such as 'they may have their reasons''it is me being too sensitive'),keep a restrained tone,reduce confrontation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing successful Artists or Thinking about doing art again
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will look down on oneself,and that trying again will surely fail(attributing one's own insecurity to others' evaluations)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use hypothetical and speculative expressions('they will not approve of me'),reduce self-disclosure,Displacement to narratives about current Work.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Low mood after repeatedly recalling failure experiences or the party absence incident at Work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing all negative consequences to one's own inadequacy,Reinforcement the self-directed 'I am a failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use self-deprecating and self-blaming statements(such as 'it is all I am not good enough'),keep a low tone,reduce mention of external situational factors.

manifestations: After the setback in attempting an art career,continuously tying self-worth to whether works sell,income,and the image of a 'successful Artist'
Repeatedly comparing between current Work and the ideal artistic identity,feeling the need to constantly prove oneself
outcomes: Overall well-being and Decreased enjoyment of life

manifestations: Siblings not yet arriving at the birthday party is experienced as being ignored and rejected
Tending to interpret one absence as the relationship not being valued
outcomes: Tense relationships with colleagues,impaired social functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Categorizing one's own feelings as 'too sensitive', appearing hesitant and restrained about expressing hurt and putting forward needs
Strict with myself in relationships, worried about disturbing others or causing conflict

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interpreting siblings' absence as 'have not prioritized me/not valued me'
Assuming others will negate oneself when seeing successful people

positive_force: Close relationships with family, able to talk about personal problems to a certain extent
Has a stable job and basic occupational functioning
Has invested a lot of time and energy in artistic pursuits, showing persistence and investment ability
Social support exists (friends and family attend the party and bring thoughtful gifts)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, personalization, and comparison are prominent
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation and money indicators
Rumination and communication avoidance maintain the negative cycle
Self-doubt leads to Sleep disturbance,Decline in work performance and Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Rumination and Self-denial(labeling a single setback or event as 'total failure')
antecedent: Recalling siblings' absence at the birthday party
Zoning out at work and replaying failure experiences
Recalling the experience of art not yet sold three years ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core beliefs 'I am a failure/I am not good enough' and an external-validation orientation,to avoid the Fear of being negated and Being rejected again
target_behavior.function: Temporarily escaping the pain of failure and Being rejected,reducing Anxiety about facing conflict and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance,Tense relationships with colleagues,Sleep affected,Decreased enjoyment of life,maintaining and worsening low self-esteem and Self-doubt
